about: SCION-25 RIVE trace: what the dog did, per scene frame, measured from the rendered dog layer (x_screen, y_screen, bbox: alpha centroid and box of the dog-only layer) and from the drawn pose (facing: muzzle left or right of the body centroid on screen; head_below_back_px: top of the skull minus top of the back, screen px, positive = head lower). The camera does not move: x_screen = 355 + 210 * (x_score - 0.24) for the body centre. state is the score state the puppet was given (its mood input).
